body: Namaste! Apollo Health Plus Pharmacy, Malviya Nagar se. Sharma ji ki 3 mahine ki dawaiyan (metformin, atorvastatin, telmisartan) 28 Apr tak khatam ho jayengi. Wahi dose, wahi brand — pack karne ke liye taiyaar. Dhyan dein: is mahine atorvastatin ke kuch batch recall hue hain — hum sirf safe batch se hi denge. Senior citizen 15% chhoot lagegi, aur ₹499 se upar free home delivery saved address par. Bhejne ke liye HAAN likhiye, ya dose mein koi badlav ho to bata dijiye.
rationale: Chronic refill: exact molecules and run-out date, only the pharmacy's live perks, a recall cross-check against this week's digest, and a respectful family-channel address in the customer's language. Levers: precision, trust, low friction. Facts: trigger.payload molecules + runout date; category.digest[d_2026W17_atorvastatin_recall] cross-check; merchant.offers (senior, delivery).

Your own mix already leans delivery — 180 delivery vs 95 dine-in orders in 30 days — so ride that. Keep 'Buy 1 Pizza Get 1 Free (Tue-Thu)' for the next weeknight match, where covers run ~18% higher. 6:30pm ke liye delivery-only 'Match-night Combo @ ₹399 (food + drink)' Insta story draft kar doon? YES bhejiye, 10 min mein kaam ho jayega.

Levers: contrarian judgment, specificity. Facts: trigger.payload match; category.digest[d_2026W17_ipl_window]; merchant.customer_aggregate delivery/dine-in.
